WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period = 8 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
),
prod AS (
  SELECT product_key,
         CASE WHEN subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE category END AS category
  FROM dim_product
),
sales AS (
  SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, prod.category, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date
  JOIN prod ON prod.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND prod.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
),
rets AS (
  SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, prod.category, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date
  JOIN prod ON prod.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND prod.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT category,
         round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amt END), 2) AS ns_prior,
         round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amt END), 2) AS ns_last
  FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category, 8 AS fiscal_period, ns_prior AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ns_last AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
       round(100.0 * (ns_last - ns_prior) / ns_prior, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM agg ORDER BY category
